breakpoints.note: Source. The first `flex` array string from the attacker-controlled nested FlexBuffer value is materialized into the sharing-enabled `flexbuffers::Builder`, creating the string-pool entry later matched by the longer second string.

The staged patch replaces this with `memcmp(..., min_len + 1)` plus a length tie-break (`a.second < b.second`), matching length-delimited string ordering and preventing the false duplicate that leaves a stale width attached to a reused offset.
